transcript:
SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/59npdZYE7ET7HrvdsxjkJyyt9Y-hd6S9

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (61 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

To explore SMB's current offerings for the Bledsoe Firm.

Key Takeaways

The Bledsoe Firm is exploring alternatives to its current fragmented marketing strategy (~$36k/mo spend) to improve ROI and scale.

SMB's "Full Service Marketing Starter" package ($5.7k/mo) offers a consolidated solution, managing up to $25k in ad spend across multiple channels.

The firm's Lawmatics CRM integration is a non-negotiable asset, as it provides critical reporting and automations that enable its current success.

A follow-up meeting is set for August 12th to review a free marketing audit and discuss AI-driven intake automation.

Topics

Firm Context & Goals

Growth: The firm has tripled in size and aims to double again in the next year, with plans for new offices in San Diego and LA.

Performance: This month is a record with 17 new clients (vs. a prior high of 9).

Goal: Consistently retain 20+ clients per month.

Intake: A paid consultation model ($200/30-min) filters for serious clients, resulting in a ~17% lead-to-consultation conversion rate.

Leadership: John Bledsoe is delegating marketing and intake ownership to Kate to focus on high-level strategy.

Current Marketing Strategy & Spend

Total Monthly Spend: ~$36,000 across multiple vendors.

Noble (Primary Agency):

Fee: $8,500/mo (down from $10k).

Services: Full-service marketing, Lawmatics CRM integration, and reporting.

Value: Highly responsive and provides qualified leads. The Lawmatics integration is considered a "goldmine" for operational clarity.

Other Vendors:

Direct Mail: ~$7,000/mo

Vertical 10 (Meta Ads): ~$4,000/mo

Google Ad Spend: ~$15,500/mo

SMB's Proposed Solution

Full Service Marketing Starter Package:

Cost: $5,700/mo management fee.

Scope: Manages up to $25,000 in ad spend.

Channels: PPC, LSAs, SEO, social media, AI avatars, connected TV, and ChatGPT ads.

Intake Automation:

Goal: Double the firm's ~17% conversion rate by optimizing the intake process.

Proposed Solution: A "Fractional CTO" (FCTO) to build custom AI automations that plug into the existing tech stack.

Example Tool: An "Intake Qualifier" that grades calls, tailors follow-ups, and coaches staff on objection handling.

Next Steps

Jacob:

Send the digital version of the "Growth Accelerator" book (with the new AI chapter) to John and Kate.

Initiate a free marketing audit to analyze the firm's current performance.

Schedule the follow-up meeting for August 12th at 1:00 PM Pacific, inviting a paid ads director.

Kate:

Prepare for the next meeting by identifying daily tasks suitable for automation.

Action Items

Email recap + AI notes + updated book to John & Kate - WATCH (5 secs)
Email Noble re: negative keywords - WATCH (5 secs)
Email scope request to Kate; then run audit and prep plan for Aug 12 - WATCH (5 secs)
Send Aug 12 1 pm PT invite to John & Kate; include Paid Ads Director; remove if not needed - WATCH (5 secs)
Draft list of daily tasks to automate for Aug 12 call - WATCH (5 secs)
Email Kumo re: post-transfer intake call recording - WATCH (5 secs)
